summary: Iteration 15 full-stack test of the pay-back flow, flat-specific charges, grouped readings entry, grouped water-usage report, per-report WhatsApp sharing, centred report headings and negative opening balance. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter15.py — 20/20 passed (payment mode/reference validation incl. payout, part-then-full pay back status transition Prepaid -> Excess Paid Back, flat-only charge maths for one-time AND recurring incl. CSV/XLSX/PDF columns, readings sorted floor->flat->meter + re-editability + statement recompute, grouped meters with combined total, centred two-line headings with no 'sorted by' text, 1 page per report / cover+4 for the pack, png+zip, negative opening balance, light regression). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920): pay-back button only on credit rows (101, 201), dialog prefilled with the exact credit, mode select + conditional reference (backend 400 surfaced as toast), part payment keeps Prepaid and shrinks credit, remainder flips to 'Excess Paid Back', ledger shows Mode/Reference and DD-MM-YYYY; readings entry grouped Ground->First->Third with flat bands, typing lands on the correct meter (incl. after clicking a sort heading), values persist and remain re-editable; water usage report heading centred with 'For the month of August 2026', flat 101's two meters grouped under one block with a single combined Total Amount (rowspan=2); every per-report WhatsApp button (usage, meters, purchases, recurring, reconciliation, pack) downloads the correct report image and opens a WhatsApp compose window with a report-specific caption; PDF/Image/Zip/Excel/CSV downloads all work; flat-only selects default to 'Split between all flats', a 3000 one-time charge billed to 102 shows only in 102's Flat-specific cell (shared Misc share unchanged for every flat) with the 'only 102' badge; negative opening dues of -2,000 show as -₹2,000.00 Bal brought forward and move the net toward credit (-4,800 -> -6,800). All Sunrise Residency data was restored to the exact baseline after testing.

minor.issue: CSV reconciliation header reads 'Total water cost' while the screen, Excel and PDF all use 'Total Water cost' — cosmetic inconsistency between export formats (server.py line ~1131).

ui_bugs.issue: Requirement 5 (remove 'sorted by floor/flat' notes) is not fully done — the pack card still reads 'the four owner reports, each sorted by floor then flat number' (MIS.jsx line 148). PDFs are clean.

Opening / outstanding dues can only be entered when ADDING a flat; the flats table cell (flat-dues-<no>) is read-only, so a negative opening balance cannot be set for an existing flat from the UI at all. Had to use PUT /api/flats to test it.

When a non-floor column heading is used for sorting, rows are still first grouped by the flat's first appearance, so the chosen sort only applies loosely — sorting by e.g. 'Water charges' does not produce a globally sorted list.

issues: Dates use the browser-native <input type=date> picker rather than the shadcn Calendar component (pre-existing across the app).
Leftover junk/test properties from earlier iterations are still seeded: 'QA Prop 817555', 'QA Prop 96e3ed', 'TEST_Carry f91e11', 'afdsfdasfdasfdas', 'srinithi' — clean up demo data.

action_items: Remove the 'each sorted by floor then flat number' sentence from the Month-end owner pack card (MIS.jsx line 148) to complete requirement 5.
Make opening/outstanding dues editable for an existing flat in the Building Setup flats table (needed for negative opening balances; currently API-only).
Align the CSV reconciliation header casing with the other exports ('Total Water cost').

Housekeeping: 18 assertions in the older suites (test_iter11_xlsx_export.py, test_iter12_fixes.py, test_iter13_booking_dues_pack.py::test_combined_pdf, test_iter14_water_charges.py::test_csv_group_band) now fail ONLY because they assert the removed 'Colour key' blocks and the old header names ('Metered cost', 'Total Water cost' in CSV) — these are stale specs, not product regressions (Excel/PDF re-verified manually: Flat-specific column present, per-flat fills present, no colour-key blocks). Update or retire those assertions.
Delete the leftover QA/TEST rental properties from the demo data.
critical_code_review_comments: Two JSX whitespace-text-node-in-<tr> React errors were logging on every render of the Reconciliation and Charges tables (ReconTable.jsx line 133, Charges.jsx line 144). Fixed by me (formatting only) — console is now clean.

engine.compute_statement is correct for flat-only charges: shared_charges drives recurring_share/adhoc_share while flat_specific is added per flat, so the shared per-flat share is untouched (verified numerically for both a one-time and a recurring flat-only charge).
POST /api/payments enforces the non-cash reference for BOTH directions (received and payout) — verified.
Reconcile.jsx defines extraCell inline (react/no-unstable-nested-components lint error) — consider hoisting; not functionally breaking.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all iteration-15 flows pass; only the leftover 'sorted by' note and the non-editable opening-dues cell fall short of the spec)

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the iteration-15 features. The iteration-14 readings bug did not reappear: Water.jsx updates state by meter_id (x.meter_id === r.meter_id) and GET/PUT /api/readings key on meter_id, so typed values stay on their own meter even after a sort-heading click, after saving and after re-editing. The 18 failures in the older suites are stale expectations: reports.py no longer emits '_legend' colour-key blocks (requirement 5/'no colour-key blocks') and xlsx.py/server.py renamed reconciliation headers and inserted the new 'Flat-specific' column, so index/label assertions written for iterations 11–14 no longer match the intended output.
